About this tile

About Alps

Alps is a stone look tile in our tiles range. It comes in six options across three colours and two sizes, all in a Matt finish. It is listed for indoor use.

A matt finish has no shine. It hides water spots and footprints and gives good grip, which makes it the usual choice for bathroom and kitchen floors.

300 x 600 suits walls and compact spaces and 600 x 600 is the easy all rounder for floors.

For slip ratings, thickness and any other detail your tiler asks for, call (02) 8786 0288 and we will check it for you.

Getting it home

Pick-up and delivery

Pick up Alps from our Bonnyrigg showroom or have it delivered across Sydney metro. The delivery cost depends on the address and the size of the order, so the team confirms it when you enquire.

Pallets of tiles are loaded by forklift onto tray-top utes and trucks with clear forklift access. Other vehicles are loaded by hand, and you need to be present while your order is loaded. Under our sales terms, goods must be picked up within 60 days of arrival. Showroom: 43-45 Bonnrigg Avenue, Bonnyrigg NSW 2177.

Before you order

Returns and batch matching

Order all the Alps you need in one go, with about 10% extra for cuts. Tiles are made in batches and the shade can differ between them, so boxes bought later may not match. Check the colour and the batch or shade before any tile is laid.

Returns are covered by our sales terms. Returned goods must be received within 14 days of the original invoice, in their original unopened cartons with the invoice number, and tiles returned must exceed 3 boxes. A 30% restocking fee applies, and goods bought during a sale period or on special cannot be returned. No claims are accepted once materials have been fixed or tiles are laid, so inspect everything at pick-up or delivery.

Questions

Ordering Alps

How many boxes of Alps do I need?

Each box covers 1.44 m². Enter your area in the calculator above and it adds 10% for cuts, then rounds up to full boxes. For 12 m² that is 10 boxes.

How much is Alps?

Alps does not show a price online. Add it to your enquiry and our showroom team confirms the price for the option and quantity you need.

What options does Alps come in?

It comes in six options across three colours and two sizes, all in a Matt finish. The options are Silver / Matt / 300 x 600, Silver / Matt / 600 x 600, Grey / Matt / 300 x 600, Grey / Matt / 600 x 600, Beige / Matt / 300 x 600 and Beige / Matt / 600 x 600. Every option is listed on this page with its code.

How do I buy Alps?

Add it to your enquiry and send it to us, call (02) 8786 0288 or visit the showroom. No payment is taken online. The team confirms stock and price with you first.

Can I pick up Alps or have it delivered?

Yes. Pick it up from the Bonnyrigg showroom, Monday to Friday 7am to 5pm and Saturday 7am to 3pm, or ask for Sydney metro delivery. The delivery cost depends on your address and the size of the order.

Will my tiles look exactly like the photos?

Colour and veining vary from tile to tile and between batches, and screens show colour differently. We recommend seeing Alps in person at our showroom before you order.

Can I return Alps?

Returns are covered by our sales terms. Returned goods must be received within 14 days of the original invoice, in their original unopened cartons with the invoice number. Tiles returned must exceed 3 boxes, and a 30% restocking fee applies.
